title: Build Your Own Legal AI Agents with Harvey Workflow Builder
format_note: Narrated screen recording of building and running one workflow in Harvey, with digital zooms and serif title cards at both ends.
one_thing: Build one two-branch buyer/supplier workflow live, step by step, then run both branches and publish it, so 'if you can define the process, you can build it' is shown.

transcript.voice_style: Calm, even, instructional narrator; second-person imperatives ('Click add step'), no hype, no music-led emphasis.
transcript.script_shape: One-sentence pitch, then a worked example narrated action by action in build order, a test run of both branches, access and publish, and a one-line close at about 2:50.

good.observation: The whole product is the story: one concrete workflow (supply agreement, buyer vs supplier) is built, run down both branches and published in 177s, so nothing is abstract.
Opens with the finished canvas for 6s before building it, so the viewer knows the destination.
Digital zoom makes small UI legible: prompt text and table rows read clearly in zoomed frames.
Live typing of the prompt and a real cursor make each step verifiable and easy to follow against the voiceover.
Restrained serif title cards on flat black or white give a premium bookend without competing with the UI.
The test run shows both branches' different output, with citations and a comparison table, which proves the conditional logic.

weak.observation: Frame 0 is a near-black frame where the wordmark fades in at 0.2s; the product first appears at 3.6s.
Sound is flat at -24.2 LUFS and -5.4 dBTP, about 10 LU under the -14 LUFS social target.
Cuts ignore the music (4.2% on strong onsets vs 8.6% chance) and the film has no energy burst.
Static or near-static stretches of up to 14s (33% of intervals static) while typing, with the only change a caret.
No closing CTA card; the film ends on a faded logo after the Workflows grid.

rule_candidates.rule: In a product walkthrough, zoom the camera into the active panel so its text exceeds about 2.6% of frame height, and return to the full window only to orient.
rule_candidates.evidence: Zoomed text legible in crops/prompt-typing.png; full window f0003.jpg labels about 9-12px.

rule_candidates.rule: Show the finished result for 5-6s before building it from empty, so the viewer holds the goal during a long build.
A narrated demo can run single takes of 30-50s if the camera re-frames every 8-10s to follow the action.
Bookend a demo with 1-3 word serif title cards of 11-16% frame height, each held at least 1.2s.
Type prompt text live at human speed in the UI with a visible caret and character counter rather than pasting finished text.
rule_candidates.skill_rule: Rule 10 (real product UI beats invented UI)

rule_candidates.rule: Prove branching logic by running each branch on camera and showing a different output for each.
rule_candidates.evidence: t=126-150s buyer list vs supplier table

rule_candidates.rule: Fade through grey or black between a flat title card and the UI over about 0.45s; this reads as intentional where a dissolve between two UIs would not.
A narrated tutorial may be quiet (-24 LUFS) but a social master still needs -14 LUFS; normalise before export.
